sources.title: Coin360 — Lighter LIT token launch: airdrop and market-maker controversy (2 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Published 2 Jan 2026. Reports that Jump Crypto received >$24M of LIT for market-making and kept ~323,956 LIT as fees, with limited upfront communication. ~$250M withdrawn within 24h of the airdrop (~20% of ~$1.4B TVL); net outflow ~$101M. CEO Novakovski: scrutinised wallets belonged to a third-party liquidity provider from the private beta; no undisclosed relationships (paraphrase). Linked wallets got ~10M LIT (~4% of circulating) after ~$5M USDC in LLP from April 2025; ~2.76M LIT (~$7.18M) sold. LIT opened ~$3.30, fell ~32% to ~$2.20, rebounded ~$2.60; ~54% of top accounts short.

sources.title: CoinGape — Lighter team under fire after alleged $7.18M LIT dump post-airdrop (1 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Published 1 Jan 2026. Researcher MLM: one entity split ~$5M USDC LLP deposit across 5 wallets and received 9,999,999.6 LIT (~1% of supply, ~4% of circulating); ~2.76M LIT sold since TGE. ZachXBT hinted at insider trading. Bubblemaps: ~$250M withdrawn in 24h ($201.9M Ethereum, $52.2M Arbitrum), ~20% of $1.4B TVL. Platform volume reportedly fell from $15B (November) to $3B. No team comment in the article.

sources.title: CoinAcademy — $250M withdrawn from Lighter less than 24h after LIT airdrop (31 Dec 2025)
sources.excerpt: Published 31 Dec 2025. Bubblemaps: $250M withdrawals in 24h. Airdrop worth ~$675M. Unnamed on-chain analysts: ~75% of recipient addresses still hold LIT, ~7% bought more. LIT >$2.70, market cap ~$678M at writing. Buyback terms not clearly defined.

sources.title: The Defiant — Lighter becomes top perp DEX by volume, reveals $68M raise (12 Nov 2025)
sources.excerpt: Published 12 Nov 2025. Lighter moved to the top of perp DEXs by volume, ahead of Hyperliquid and Aster; founder Vladimir Novakovski described as a former AI entrepreneur; $68M raise led by Founders Fund and Ribbit at ~$1.5B.

sources.title: KuCoin Ventures weekly report — Lighter's sector disruption (6 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Published 6 Jan 2026 (KuCoin is an exchange; has its own listing interest). TGE 30 Dec 2025, 25% airdropped (~$675M), no vesting on airdrop. TVL grew to >$1.2B in H2-2025 (DefiLlama chart). ~20% of DEX perp market by end-2025; 30d volume briefly >$200B. OI ~$1.4B vs Hyperliquid ~$8B (undated, DefiLlama). Volume/OI ratio consistently above peers; frequent small leveraged trades to farm points ('wash trading' — no direct proof). Retail 0% taker fee; estimated annualised revenue ~$105M vs >$800M for Hyperliquid on similar volume. ~1 point ≈ 20 LIT; est. 75% retention.

sources.title: The Defiant — Lighter token struggles as farmers transition to alternative exchanges (12 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Published 12 Jan 2026 20:33 UTC. Summary: LIT down nearly 30% over the past week as points farmers move to other exchanges. Article body did not load; no figures available.

sources.title: TechFlow — perp DEX comparison incl. Lighter volume/OI and LLP performance (18 Nov 2025)
sources.excerpt: Published 18 Nov 2025. Lighter 24h volume $12.78B vs OI $1.591B (ratio ~8); 30-day $294B volume vs $47B cumulative OI (6.25), called 'clear farming behavior'. >56,000 users within weeks of the 2 Oct 2025 launch; $1.1B TVL within weeks; November share 27.7% of perp-DEX volume and 12.5% of OI (24h, undated). In the 10–11 Oct crash Lighter had a ~4h outage after a database failure and its LLP lost money while Hyperliquid's HLP stayed profitable.

sources.title: Bitrue blog (sponsored) — LIT price analysis: why is it going up? (7 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Published 7 Jan 2026; sponsored exchange content, figures not independently verified. On 6 Jan the treasury spent USDC to buy ~180,700 LIT; an assistance fund bought ~165,790 LIT at ~$3.05 (undated). LIT ~$3.09; 24h volume ~$36M (undated).

sources.title: Capwolf — Lighter LIT token surges 16% on buyback launch (6 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Published 6 Jan 2026. Explorer reportedly showed ~180,000 LIT and ~$1.35M in stablecoins in the treasury; no executed buyback amount reported. LIT ~$3.06; past-week range $2.33–$3.37. Session (5–6 Jan) spot volume ~$157.8M, derivatives volume ~$21M, OI ~$1.81M (aggregator source not named).
